name: Plesetsk LC-41/1
tagline: Tsiklon-3 / Kosmos-3M workhorse — 310+ launches across the Soviet/Russian era
description: Plesetsk's LC-41/1 pad served as the primary launch site for Tsiklon-3 and Kosmos-3M rockets across more than three decades. Located at NIIP-53 in Russia's far north, the pad supported a vast catalogue of military reconnaissance, navigation, and communications satellites. Decommissioned after Tsiklon-3 retired, the pad remains historically significant as one of Plesetsk's busiest.
